title: Repeat-Redraw Fee on the Closing and Funding Redraw Schedule
content:
The repeat-redraw fee on the Closing and Funding redraw schedule is set from the number of doc redraw fee charges on the closing, every such charge counted, the latest being the redraw being priced.

| Redraw being priced | Repeat-redraw fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| the first doc redraw fee charge on the closing | none |
| the second | 20.00 |
| the third | 40.00 |
| the fourth or later | 40.00 |

**Clause.** Where the redraw being priced is the third or a later one, the repeat-redraw fee is 40.00; where it is the second, it is 20.00; otherwise there is none.

Hypothetical: a closing whose fee ledger shows two doc redraw fee charges prices the latest at a repeat-redraw fee of 20.00; a reversal naming the first of them does not change the count of charges.
